sloka: ततः कृच्छ्रात् समासाद्य सञ्ज्ञां राक्षसपुङ्गवः।कुम्भकर्णवधाद्दीनो विललाप स रावणः ।। ६.६८.९ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kṛcchrāt samāsādya sañjñāṁ rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।kumbhakarṇavadhāddīno vilalāpa sa rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.68.9 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the foremost of the Rakshasas regained consciousness with great difficulty and awakened to the situation of Kumbhakarna's destruction, wailed disturbed in mind.
